Curious about comprehensive cancer screening in Saudi Arabia?

King Faisal Specialist Hospital in Riyadh offers an all‑inclusive outpatient oncology screening pathway.
The package includes a physician‑led consultation, blood tests, tumor marker panels and imaging such as mammography or CT.
After testing, you receive a detailed written report and a follow‑up consultation, either in person or virtual.

Read the full guide:
